# Sotheby's

> Sotheby's is a premier global auction house offering fine art, jewelry, watches, wine, and luxury goods through both live auctions and online marketplaces.

Sotheby's operates major auction centers in New York, Hong Kong, and Paris, specializing in contemporary and modern art, Asian art, luxury fashion, and high-value collectibles. The platform combines traditional auction experiences with digital catalogues and immediate-sale options for collectors worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Contemporary Art
- Fine Art Auctions
- Asian Art
- Luxury Fashion

## Auctions & Sales Calendar

- [Sotheby's Homepage](https://www.sothebys.com/en): Sotheby's homepage: premier fine art, jewelry, watches, wine auctions.
- [Upcoming Auctions Calendar](https://www.sothebys.com/en/calendar): Sotheby's complete auction calendar with upcoming sales and events.
- [The Hong Kong Sales](https://www.sothebys.com/en/the-hong-kong-sales): Major Sotheby's Hong Kong auction event featuring modern contemporary art.

## Fine Art & Auctions

- [Asian Art Series](https://www.sothebys.com/en/series/asian-art): Sotheby's Asian Art auction sales with Chinese and Indian art.

- [Fine Art Editions & Prints](https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/fine-art/print): Sotheby's fine art editions and prints marketplace online.
